answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 155 identities means 155 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the hollow pair is tracked in the canyon ledger, the bridge audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 51%. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
